column6: comment
a conative label — GoEmotions 'desire' bridges to teleology's gmeow:Desire, not to any emotion type
grief is an intense, bereavement-scoped sadness — a narrower reading, so the GoEmotions label broad-matches the canonical sadness type
SST-2 NEGATIVE is a valence appraisal of the target text (below midpoint), never an emotion — relatedMatch to the valence axis
SST-2 POSITIVE is a valence appraisal of the target text (above midpoint), never an emotion — relatedMatch to the valence axis
an affective expression observed over a span is annotation-shaped; relatedMatch — an expression is evidence, not a bare annotation
the gmeow cognitive appraisal axes (novelty, goal-relevance, coping, norm-compatibility, …) relate to EmotionML's Scherer appraisal set — set-level, the appraisal-family analogue
the gmeow core-affect axes (valence / arousal / dominance / unpredictability) relate to EmotionML's PAD dimension set — set-level, closest of the EmotionML dimension vocabularies
MFOEM_000001 'emotion process'; closeMatch — GMEOW's Emotion is the endurant mode, MFOEM's is the occurrent process, so not exact

the gmeow emotion-category vocabulary relates to EmotionML's 'everyday' category set — a set-level association, not a per-term equivalence
a model run is a prov:Activity; closeMatch, since GMEOW pins richer model provenance than PROV requires
